criteria.text: States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 30 May 2028 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 30 November 2030 (48 months after Closing).
Identifies that the basket in SPA Section 9.4 ($1,275,000) operates as a deductible (Seller liable only for the excess), not a tipping basket, and explains that this is less favourable to the Buyer.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 45-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.

Identifies that the core platform was developed by contractor Dunmore Media Ltd without a written IP assignment, so the Company may not own it, and recommends obtaining a confirmatory assignment as a condition to Closing.
States the survival periods as durations and as dates (30 May 2028; 30 November 2030) and gives days remaining to the general-warranty expiry from 14 October 2026 (594 days).
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
